description: This is a unit test class for the QuickLaunchDao component within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin. It primarily tests the retrieval of quick launch items based on different configurations and fixture data.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing QuickLaunchDao's methods related to fetching quick launch items within the dashboard plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of QuickLaunchDao, loads configuration, and sets up mock services.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of quick launch list when modules are enabled with defined periods.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of quick launch list specific to ESS when modules are enabled with defined periods.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList2
methods.description: Tests retrieval of quick launch list when modules are enabled but periods are undefined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS2
methods.description: Tests retrieval of quick launch list for ESS with modules enabled but no periods defined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList3
methods.description: Tests retrieval of quick launch list when the leave module is disabled.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS3
methods.description: Tests retrieval of ESS-specific quick launch list when leave module is disabled.
